what: The mount table (/proc/self/mountinfo) PID 1 should read after the share step, for the five kinds of share, as Linux v6.18 prints it.
provenance: NOT captured from a running guest: no VM may be started from this lane. Each virtio-fs line is assembled from the v6.18 source of the functions that print it (below), with PID 1's mount flags. The live table of a booted guest is gate G7's check and replaces these lines then.
kernel: Linux v6.18 tag (the guest kernel pin is 6.18.35; scripts/cowork-guest-artifact/kernel/base-apple-6.18.35.config has CONFIG_FUSE_DAX=y and CONFIG_VIRTIO_FS=y)

derivedFrom.says: ID PARENT MAJ:MIN ROOT MOUNTPOINT then ro|rw and ,nosuid ,nodev ,noexec ,relatime (in that order), optional tags, ' - ', the type, the source (r->mnt_devname: virtio-fs has no show_devname), then ro|rw and the filesystem's show_options
user_id, group_id and the other legacy options only when fc->legacy_opts_show; under CONFIG_FUSE_DAX, ',dax=never' when fc->dax_mode == FUSE_DAX_NEVER
the context is kzalloc'ed (legacy_opts_show false: no legacy options are printed); 'dax=never' parses to FUSE_DAX_NEVER; the source is the tag, and an unknown tag is -EINVAL
fc->dax_mode = dax_mode, before any DAX device check

contextLines: Only the five virtio-fs lines are judged; the other lines (the pseudo-filesystems and the data volume, as PID 1 mounts them) are context, and their filesystem-specific options are illustrative.
